Write-ahead log ¶

Every mutation is appended to the write-ahead log before it is applied to the tree. The log is fsynced in groups, which keeps latency low while still bounding the amount of data that a crash can lose.

Compaction ¶

Compaction merges sorted runs in the background. It is throttled by the write rate so that foreground latency stays predictable even when the disk is close to saturation.

Contents of a run are immutable once written, which makes snapshots cheap and lets readers proceed without taking locks.
